questions.q: One major way human beings biologically share in God's creative activity is through ____________.
questions.explain: According to the CRS syllabus based on Genesis 1:28, human beings share in God's ongoing creative work through **marriage and procreation**—bringing new life into the world.

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of things invented by human beings, demonstrating their share in God's creative wisdom?
questions.explain: While God created the natural universe (mountains, stars, rivers), He endowed humanity with intelligence and creativity. Things like **aeroplanes, cars, and buildings** are inventions by humans, reflecting the creative image of God.

questions.q: According to the biblical command in Genesis 1:28, which of the following is a primary purpose of marriage?
options: To be fruitful, multiply, and fill the earth
questions.explain: In **Genesis 1:28**, God blessed the first human beings and said to them, 'Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth,' which points to **procreation** as a key purpose of marriage.

questions.q: In the New Testament, Jesus demonstrated His support and blessing for marriage by attending a wedding ceremony. Where did this take place? (John 2:1)
questions.explain: According to **John 2:1**, Jesus and His disciples attended a wedding in **Cana in Galilee**, where He performed His first miracle by turning water into wine, thereby honouring the marriage institution.

questions.q: According to Genesis 2:24, what is the biblical definition of the physical and spiritual union in marriage?
options: A man and a woman agreeing to share finances
A man leaving his parents to cleave to his wife, and they become one flesh
Two families uniting to build a community
A man taking dominance over a woman
questions.explain: **Genesis 2:24** states: 'Therefore a man shall leave his father and his mother and hold fast to his wife, and they shall become **one flesh**.'

questions.q: Apostle Paul's teaching in Ephesians 5:21-31 emphasizes a specific responsibility in marriage. Husbands are instructed to ____________ their wives.
questions.explain: In **Ephesians 5:25**, Paul instructs, 'Husbands, **love** your wives, as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her.'

questions.q: One of the modern social and health benefits of fidelity in a Christian marriage is the prevention of ____________.
questions.explain: The CRS syllabus highlights that one purpose of marriage is preventing sexual immorality, which in turn helps in the prevention of Sexually Transmitted Diseases (**STDs**) and **HIV/AIDS**.

questions.q: When humans invent things like cars, aeroplanes, and architecture, they are essentially ____________.
options: sharing in God's creative activities using the intellect He gave them
trying to reach heaven to challenge God
relying on evil spirits for wisdom
questions.explain: Human inventions reflect the image of God in man. By creating tools and infrastructure, humans use their God-given wisdom and therefore **share in God's creative activities**.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a fundamental purpose of marriage according to Christian teachings?
questions.explain: The recognized purposes of marriage include companionship, procreation, and preventing immorality. **Evading taxes** is illegal and completely unrelated to biblical marriage.

questions.q: Before God created Eve, He noted that it was not good for man to be ____________.
questions.explain: In **Genesis 2:18**, God said, 'It is not good that the man should be **alone**; I will make him a helper fit for him.' This highlights companionship as a key reason for marriage.
